name: customer_transform
description: Active customers enriched with their order value band.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS name, COALESCE(c.country, 'UNKNOWN') AS country, CASE WHEN o.amount > 100 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS value_band, o.order_id AS order_id FROM raw.customer c LEFT JOIN raw.order o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
